gloss: to talk all night; to talk till dawn

definitions.gloss: to talk all night; to talk till dawn
definitions.explanation: To spend the whole night talking, usually with friends one has not seen for a long time or about something one cares about.

examples.japanese: ⟦{一晩中|ひとばんじゅう}→一晩中：20338_hitobanjuu⟧{語|かた}り{明|あ}かした。
⟦{久|ひさ}しぶり→久しぶり：01711_hisashiburi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{語|かた}り{明|あ}かした。
examples.english: I talked through the night with a friend I hadn't seen for ages.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修学旅行|しゅうがくりょこう}→修学旅行：05590_shuugakuryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{将来|しょうらい}→将来：01438_shourai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{語|かた}り{明|あ}かした。
examples.english: On the night of the school trip, we all stayed up till morning talking about our dreams for the future.

notes:
⟦{語|かた}る→語る：01930_kataru⟧ (to talk, tell) + ⟦{明|あ}かす→明かす：12961_akasu⟧ (to spend the night until dawn). Usually in the past tense, recalling a good night.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{一晩|ひとばん}→一晩：08887_hitoban⟧{語|かた}り{明|あ}かす: to talk the whole night
- ⟦{夜通|よどお}し→夜通し：12169_yodooshi⟧{語|かた}り{明|あ}かす: to talk right through the night
- ⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{語|かた}り{明|あ}かす: to talk all night about one's dreams

RELATED WORDS:
- {飲|の}み{明|あ}かす: to drink all night
- {泣|な}き{明|あ}かす: to cry all night
- {夜|よ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{明|あ}かす→明かす：12961_akasu⟧: to spend the night (awake)
